bb0bb90e5c.q: Why did a college graduate choose to enlist in the Marine Corps instead of pursuing a traditional career path?
bb0bb90e5c.a: Benjamin Barron enlisted because he was unhappy with himself after wasting four years in college without effort, had no idea what he wanted to do, and saw military service in the lives of men he respected. 8be5ccf615.q: What is the financial and temporal cost of training Arabic linguists in the Marine Corps?
8be5ccf615.a: The Marine Corps spends almost two years and a quarter of a million dollars getting Arabic linguists to the point where they can do the job. They then have five-year contracts because the language schools are so long. Linguists typically spend two years in training, three years doing the job, and then often leave for civilian contractors or the NSA where they can make double the salary doing the same work.

55b0d9c5ed.q: What was the timeline and circumstances of Benjamin Barron's deployment to Marine Corps boot camp?

Initially recruiters wanted to push it back to January so he could spend Christmas at home and be better prepared, but the day of December 9th arrival, he learned he was being sent as a backup for another recruit. He received the call at approximately 5 a.m. that morning telling him to ship that day.

82e07f73b5.q: What separates billionaire investors from everyday investors when evaluating investment risk?

If you have losses, you stop compounding, and a portfolio that is volatile with higher returns actually leaves you with less money at the end of the day than something boring and steady.
